tool_signatures.name: createMailboxAppPassword
tool_signatures.description: Create a revocable IMAP, SMTP, and JMAP credential. A mailbox can have at most five active app passwords. The secret is returned once in the 201 response and is never stored by Shipmail. Expiration defaults to 90 days and cannot exceed one year. Idempotency-Key is rejected because replaying a cached plaintext secret would violate the one-time-secret guarantee.

tool_signatures.name: createMailboxExport
tool_signatures.description: Queue a fail-closed ZIP snapshot of one mailbox. If a completed export for this mailbox is younger than 15 minutes, that export is returned with status 200 instead of creating a new one. Archived mailboxes reuse their exact current billing snapshot without restoring the mailbox. Subscribe to the mailbox.export.completed and mailbox.export.failed webhook events instead of polling the returned export. At most 24 exports per mailbox per rolling 24 hours; beyond that the endpoint returns 429 with Retry-After. Exports are for backups, not for polling for new mail: use GET /messages, GET /mailboxes/{id}/inbox/messages, or webhooks to keep inbound mail in sync.

tool_signatures.name: createMailboxFolder

tool_signatures.name: createMailboxForwarding
tool_signatures.description: Send a confirmation email to a forwarding destination. Forwarding becomes active only after the recipient confirms. Active forwarding keeps a copy in the Shipmail mailbox and excludes messages classified as spam. Repeating this request for a pending destination sends a new confirmation link.

tool_signatures.name: createMailboxImport
tool_signatures.description: Import mail from another provider into this mailbox. IMAP sources run over the source provider's IMAP with an app or device password. File sources import staged uploads (complete Google Takeout ZIPs or VCF files, Proton or Tuta EML exports, and generic MBOX or EML zips). File imports always import all dates, spam, and trash; file-source options are ignored. Google Takeout contacts embedded in the archive are imported automatically. The import runs in the background, preserves folders, read state, and dates, deduplicates, and can be re-run safely.

tool_signatures.name: createMailboxImportUpload
tool_signatures.description: Prepare a provider-bound multipart upload for a mailbox export file up to 100 GB. Accepted files are .mbox, .mbox.gz, .zip, and .eml, plus .vcf for Google Takeout. Split the file using part_size_bytes, PUT each raw part to its matching parts[].upload_url, record each response ETag, and call completeMailboxImportUpload. Then pass file_id to createMailboxImport with the same files provider. Upload sessions expire after six days. Completed staged files that are never used are deleted after 24 hours.

tool_signatures.name: createMailboxInboxDraft
tool_signatures.description: Save a new message (not a reply) to the mailbox's Drafts folder for a person to review, edit, and send from Shipmail or any mail client. Recipients must be allowed by the API key's recipient limits.

tool_signatures.description: Send an email from a mailbox. Provide from (email address) or mailbox_id to identify the sender. Prefer from when you know the mailbox email address; Shipmail resolves it to a mailbox ID. At least one of html or text is required. Total recipients (to + cc + bcc) must not exceed 50. Attachments are base64-encoded, max 20 files, 3 MB per file, 3 MB total. To send from a transactional sender (https://shipmail.to/docs/features/transactional-email), set from to its bare address; mailbox_id is optional and, when set, must be the sender's mailbox. Shipmail adds the sender name and Reply-To. Transactional senders send immediately only and refuse scheduled_at, track_reply: true, staged_attachment_ids, a different reply_to and a different display name. A transactional email send that reaches a ceiling returns 429 with details[].code application_daily_limit (daily ceiling for transactional email, a share of the organization's daily sending limit), application_unique_recipients (hourly ceiling of different recipients) or application_storage_full (the sender's mailbox has no transactional email storage left).

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_compose_message_with_file

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_create_audience

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_create_automation

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_create_mailbox

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_create_mailbox_export

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_create_mailbox_folder

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_create_mailbox_import

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_create_mailbox_rule

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_create_newsletter

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_create_reply_scan

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_delete_audience

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_delete_booking_page

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_delete_calendar_event

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_delete_domain

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_delete_inbox_message

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_delete_mailbox
tool_signatures.description: Delete a mailbox. This is destructive.

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_delete_mailbox_folder

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_delete_mailbox_forwarding
tool_signatures.description: Remove a pending or active mailbox forwarding destination.

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_delete_mailbox_rule
tool_signatures.description: Delete one deterministic inbox rule by exact rule ID. Bulk deletion is unavailable. expected_position detects concurrent reordering.

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_delete_webhook
tool_signatures.description: Delete a webhook endpoint. This is destructive.

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_get_mailbox

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_get_mailbox_delivery_routing
tool_signatures.description: Read how new messages sent to a mailbox

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_get_mailbox_export

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_get_mailbox_import

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_get_mailbox_inbox_message
tool_signatures.description: Fetch one exact JMAP inbox message.

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_get_mailbox_inbox_thread

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_get_mailbox_rule
tool_signatures.description: Fetch one deterministic inbox rule by exact rule ID for a mailbox.

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_get_member

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_get_message
tool_signatures.description: Fetch one message by ID.

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_get_newsletter

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_get_organization_access
tool_signatures.description: Check whether the organization can create mailboxes now: plan, has_access, trial state and end, trial eligibility, mailbox limit and usage, and whether newsletters are allowed. tool_signatures.name: shipmail_get_reply_scan
tool_signatures.description: Retrieve completed historical reply scan metadata and its candidate count.

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_get_scheduled_message
tool_signatures.description: Inspect one future scheduled message or undo-send hold, including its recipients, body, and attachment metadata.

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_get_subscriber

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_get_webhook
tool_signatures.description: Fetch webhook endpoint configuration by ID.

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_list_domains
tool_signatures.description: List domains in the authenticated Shipmail organization.

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_list_mailbox_app_passwords

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_list_mailbox_folders

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_run_automation

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_run_newsletter_preflight

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_schedule_newsletter
tool_signatures.description: Schedule a newsletter for delivery to its audience.

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_search_domains

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_send_inbox_reply_draft

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_send_message

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_send_newsletter_test

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_update_mailbox_folder

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_update_mailbox_rule
tool_signatures.description: Update one deterministic inbox rule by exact rule ID. Custom folder targets belong to the mailbox. expected_position detects concurrent reordering.

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_update_newsletter

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_update_subscriber

tool_signatures.name: shipmail_upload_newsletter_asset_with_file
